notes.title: Patch 1.1b
notes.content:
A few small changes.

General

Corrected a few places where busts weren't displayed properly in various locations.
Changed some tileset graphics to move away from RPG Maker RTP to a slightly more distinct look and feel.
Davos no longer has a weird neckerchief... thing.
Corrected a problem in multiple sections where certain assets could be improperly displayed under the character rather than over them if you load from a save.
BUG FIX: If you have a high refresh 4k monitor and were experiencing severe slowdown on the experience screen, this problem should be resolved.

notes.title: Patch 1.1a
notes.content:
A few small non-critical changes and one quality of life update

General

The Ghostwriter's Quill is now reusable! Return to Joseph Cline to get a new one if you used it previously and had lost it.
Multiple shops - In some places the shopkeep would be turned in the wrong direction if they were on the right side after the shop window appeared. This has been corrected.


Chapter 3

Auryn erroneously calls out Davos by his canon name, rather than by what the player may have named him at the end of the chapter. This has been corrected.


Chapter 5

Fixed a character bust not being properly displayed on a moveable crate in the LEGION checkpoint.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
The first major patch of Heroes of Spyria! Here's what's new

General

Character busts - All text interactions have had their square images replaced with fully realized character busts
Nameable characters - All main characters are now nameable
Side quest tracking - The world map can now be used to track where to go for side quests you have available
Pettable dogs - Several dogs have been added to various cities and towns. Yes, they are pettable.


Other noteable changes

Corrected a bug where the 2nd accessory wouldn't always be given back to a player when a character leaves the party
Reworked the conveyor room in Chapter 3 to make it less buggy. Again.
Nerfed rat's claw dance in Chapter 1, which now takes account for defense.
The Ghostwriter's Quill can now change the names of any of your party members, rather than just Hiro.
Madilyn now gains Inner Focus at level 36.

notes.title: Patch 1.09b
notes.content:
A few small but urgent patches.

Chapter 4

 Fixed an issue where the game could lock when talking to Willaby the fisherman from the right side. (oops)
 Fixed an issue where the game could go to a Game Over screen when switching party groups. 


Expect a rather substantial patch in around a week or two. 1.1 is coming soon!

notes.title: Patch 1.09a
notes.content:
Small but urgent patch.

Chapter >2

Prevent a bug that could allow the chapter 2 intro to be replayed if the player started from the demo, thus setting the chapters out of order and causing multiple game-breaking problems.

notes.title: Patch 1.09
notes.content:
General

Corrected a typo in the Darkness spell.
Fixed several more typos (tenant, wence, rediculous)
Fixed issue where the overlay in the casino could become improperly loaded.

Chapter 1

Added a chest near the Dregmines entrance.
Fixed typo in shallow waters around the coast.

Chapter 2

Fixed an issue in the Order of the Wind secret library where the librarian could be walked over.
Fixed an issue where some LEGION members could be invisible in the sewers.

Chapter 4

Fixed a backtracking issue on the islands around the Temple of the Source

notes.title: Patch 1.08
notes.content:
Mostly graphical and re-balancing changes.

General

Zeroed out all speeds for casting spells. Previously some spells could be cast that wouldn't take effect until after the next player's action. This shouldn't happen anymore.
Fixed an issue where Winter could speak at Astoria Bay if she wasn't in the party.
Fixed a global issue where viewing a bromide in an area where the screen was tinted would remove the tint.
Changed the Soulstone to only be equipable by Madilyn.
Fixed the wrong characters speaking, etc, if the player encounters the caretakers post chapter 4.
Fixed a slight graphical glitch at Auryn's beach.
Made Kit's Bangle only equipable to Winter.
Fixed the wrong character being shown in Fort Tetryn post chapter 3.
Fixed a typo in the Sun Revenant quest.
Fixed an issue where 3 quests weren't counted on the save screen for overall completed quests.


Chapter 3

Corrected main character improperly displaying when leaving Winter's mother's house.
Fixed a typo that told the player they received more gold than they actually did in the LEGION camp.


Chapter 4

Corrected main character improperly displaying when in the catacombs/foundations.
Fixed a speech issue of one of the Ivalace orphans in relation to the missing orphan sidequest.
Corrected main character briefly improperly displaying at the end of Cultists & Catacombs sidequest.
Fixed an issue where the wrong troops would attack the player post chapter 3 in Raven's Keep if the players didn't choose to save the royal family.
Fixed a typo on the ship.
Fixed an issue where the player could become invisible at the final seal.
Made the first platform at the end of chapter 4 reversible, allowing the player to backtrack if needed.
Considerably buffed the tower guardians in the towers of the sun revenant.


Chapter 5

Fixed a glitch that would count escaped fights as slain demons.
Jade Necklace in chapter 5 replaced with Ring of Ultimate Focus due to problematic activations.

notes.title: Patch 1.07
notes.content:
Quick patch for hook-ins for upcoming demo.
No mainline updates otherwise. (Nothing to see here) :)

notes.title: Patch 1.06b
notes.content:
Short small patch

General

Fixed Morris not being able to cast his "What time is it?" ability [spoiler]in subsequent encounters.[/spoiler]
Fixed an issue w/ the Kaliko Village Inn displaying a black screen if the player didn't trigger the cutscene in chapter 1.

notes.title: Patch 1.06a
notes.content:
New Feature

    The game now has an "Assist Mode", accessible from the player menu.
    This mode is indented for players who want an easier time with the game. (think "story mode") You can opt in for either or both of the following assistive items at any time. Opting in is a 1 way street.

        A KEY ITEM that can be used at any time to set the party members level to maximum (50).
        An ACCESSORY that will disable all random encounters when equipped.
    Both of these assists also come with 1 million gold.
    WARNING: Accepting either or both of these assists will disable the ability to earn Steam achievements for the remainder of the playthrough. (You are warned about this multiple times)

Chapter 4

    Fixed a bug where the player could get Cid stuck while helping fix
    Cave of the Moon Revenant - Fixed a bug where the screen would go black and stay black if the player re-entered the dungeon after leaving.

Post-game

    The Prodigal Son sidequest - Fixed an issue where this quest couldn't be completed post-game.

notes.title: Patch 1.05c
notes.content:
Another quick patch. 
General

Modified the start menu. Pressing the social media buttons with a controller will no longer open multiple windows per second. (oops)

Chapter 3

Added a few extra fixes to the conveyor room to make doubly sure the player doesn't get stuck.

Post-game

Fixed a graphical problem that prevented the "Press blah blah to enter the ship/airship" message from being displayed.

notes.title: Patch 1.05b
notes.content:
A few quick adjustments.
Chapter 3

Adjusted the conveyor room to (hopefully) prevent players from getting stuck.

Chapter 4

Catacombs - Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck if pushing the 2nd crystal up.

Post-game

Walleye Docks - Fixed a visual glitch that would display the town incorrectly after completing the "Razing a family" side-quest post game.

notes.title: Patch 1.05a
notes.content:
Quick hotfix for a minor glitch I missed.
Chapter 3

Fixed a graphical bug that put the player under a bridge while being on top of it in the ancient cave system.

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
A lot to go over here. Let's get started.
General

Overhauled several of the monster graphics.
Added new monster "Dungeon Dweller" to Ivalace basement.
Added "Potion Gnomes" to several locations throughout the game. These gnomes aren't particularly threatening to the players directly, but will buff their allies considerably. Address them as necessary. 
Added "Kobold Rogues" to the mix in the ancient cave system.
Fixed out of place dialog if speaking to patrons of the Joseph Cline museum after speaking to Joseph Cline.
Game EXP now properly caps at level 50.
Fixed a bug where the airship could get permanently lost if parking it in the wrong spots.
Fixed wording of Gamble Strike to properly describe what it does.
Sword skill Aura of Sacrifice can no longer be used in the menus out of combat.
Fixed wording of Improved Initiative to properly describe what it does.
Reworked Death Mark to no longer be an instant cast. Now damages the enemy before applying the mark.
Fixed a graphical bug where Madilyn would erroneously appear on the boat and airship twice.
Fixed dialog with East Ishtar Trading Company if the player had completed their sidequest.
Fixed dialog with participants to reflect the current state of things post summit.
Fixed dialog if the player returns to Sanchi Verde after chapter 3 to properly display dialog on locked doors.
Auryn's House - Updated dialog for players examining the diary post chapter 3.

Chapter 4

Golden City - Fixed a bug that would keep the screen dark if the player escaped from caretakers and eventually kill them.
Golden City - Fixed a bug where the store rooms couldn't be accessed if the lava was up.
Ivalace - Fixed poor King Firestorm being able to be walked through. He is now solid once more.
Bredon - Modified the graphic of the statue in the town square.
Bredon - Modified a section of log that should have been solid.
Final Seal - Fixed a fire pit that the player could erroneously walk over.
Floating Island Cave - Fixed a few segments where the player could walk out of bounds.
Floating Islands - Fixed a bug where a crystal could take the player to places they shouldn't go.
Multiple locations - Fixed a lot of dialog for multiple NPCs to reflect the state of the world post summit. (Some may have been missed)
Sun Revenant Eastern Tower - Floor 10 can now be backtracked to from the top floor. Why you would want to do this is your own business, but now you can. :) 
Cave of the Moon Revenant - Fixed a bug where tide would return, blocking player access to backtracking.

Chapter 5

Golden City - Fixed an issue with torches not being properly lit if the player returns.
Birchwood Grove - Fixed dialog with an old lady erroneously addressing the party.
Raven's Keep - Adjusted the placement of the royal family.
Ivalace - Fixed a bug that would allow the player to skip a short segment when moving through the city.
Ivalace - Buffed a fight to ensure its inevitable outcome.
Floating Island - Corrected some dialog when trying to leave an area.

Post Game

Walleye Docks area - Changed the battlebacks of the area to properly reflect regional changes.

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
A few notable things here.
General

Added a couple new monsters to the mix.
[olist]
Yeti - Found around chapters 2 and 3. Will throw a snowball at the player which will make them extra vulnerable to ice damage before casting Blizzard.
Firefly - Similar, but found around chapter 4. Will make a player vulnerable to fire before casting Flame II.
[/olist]
Increased chance of encountering a Lamia in the desert and gave them a new ability. Enthrall - uncleansable, lasts 2 rounds. Like confuse except the player will absolutely attack an ally.
Defensive Shell ability - corrected this to last the proper amount of turns.
Pestilence Boils ability - Fixed so this couldn't be activated out of combat.
Spirit Shell ability - Fixed so this couldn't be activated out of combat.
Spirit Shell ability - Clarified text description of the ability.
Warrior's Focus ability - Now properly raises Hiro's attack.

Chapter 3

Implemented a partial fix for causing problems when switching parties if the party member was on a conveyor belt. It's still possible, but requires a high degree of timing and intent. IE won't be able to do it accidentally now. (probably) 

Chapter 4

Golden City - Fixed an area that would replay a previously played cutscene erroniously.
Golden City - Fixed a problem that disabled saves. NOTE: they would have been enabled past this room anyways, but there wasn't a good reason to disable them where they were disabled. I believe saving is still disabled in this room.
Golden City Inn: 2F - Fixed a bug where the player could go out of bounds.
Old Raven's Keep - Fixed a bug where crystals would reappear in wardstone room if you had previously completed the associated quest.
Ivalace Holding Area - Fixed a bug where a bottle could be broken multiple times. (Visual only, didn't impact progression)

notes.title: Minor hotfix
notes.content: Modified the Sunstone artifact. New effect: Disables random encounters.

notes.title: Patch 1.03a
notes.content:
Quick patch to correct some minor bugs.

Chapter 4

Sanchi Verde - Corrected dialog if the player returns to this location post chapter 3.
Doveport - Fixed a bug where it was possible for Hiro to be the only player in the party if he enters a certain house and leaves without interacting with anything.
Doveport - The old lady will now properly remove apples from the player's inventory when they are offered to her.
Cultists & Catacombs - Fixed an issue where it was possible for the game to softlock if an NPC was in the way of movement in the graveyard.
Cultists & Catacombs - Removed the ability to use items while playing. This was done using a new method and (hopefully) won't have any unintended consequences.
Overworld - Added a barrier to prevent the player from moving on to Birchwood Grove if they haven't gone to the transference tower first. (Winter's party)
Birchwood Grove - Fixed some dialog displayed when interacting with stoves.
Birchwood Grove - Fixed a glitch that would change the sprites of certain NPCs improperly if interacted with.

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
A lot of stuff to go over here.
General

Reworked the pygmy chief's spear. It now has a high chance to apply a burn debuff. Burn is weaker than poison and will wear off after 2 or 3 ticks.
Hiro will now properly learn Tackle, which is basically a stronger Pommel Strike.
Madilyn will no longer learn Sleep a second time at level 22. Instead, she will acquire the Spear skill "Silencaga", which is a multiple hit silence for 30TP. 
Removed the gravestone of James Deth from Jarith.
Fixed a section leading up to Walleye Docks where players were erroneously able to be attacked while on the path.
Fixed the ship whistle not functioning from the dock south of Auryn's house.
Removed contraband from the weapon shop in Raven's Keep.
Removed Magnus' chatter from The Frostbite after he's gone on his way.
Fixed some dialog with an NPC inside Jarith's pub.
Fixed some dialog when interacting w/ a barrel at the Icedale bridge.
Fixed the weather in the desert when entering from the Amorian or Ishtarian outposts.

Chapter 2

Fixed a bug that could cause the player to become stuck when moving through the broken window in Icedale Castle 2F.

Chapter 3

Snowy Cave - Fixed an area where the player could go out of bounds.
Walleye Docks - Corrected some dialog in WInter's mother's house.
Walleye Docks - Fixed a problem where the incorrect map could be loaded when leaving Winter's mother's house after completing the "Razing a family" sidequest.
Fort Tetryn - Fixed a sequence breaking area where the player could slip past the western guards.
Fort Tetryn - Fixed a problem where the player could become stuck behind the counter in the item shop after examining the clock.
Fort Tetryn Inn 2F - Fixed an area where the players could go out of bounds.
LEGION Camp - Added an interior for a tent that was previously inaccessible. 
LEGION Camp - Fixed a problem where the exit guards would react to Davos even if he hadn't saved the prisoner yet.
Raven's Keep Sewers - Corrected an area that allowed the player to go out of bounds.
Old Raven's Keep - Fixed an NPC who wouldn't take gold from the player if they donated. Also stopped them from selling smelling salts indefinitely.
Old Raven's Keep: The Angry Billygoat - The tavern owner now takes the correct gold from the player. (I wouldn't recommend it though. I hear the mattresses are rough and they never change the sheets.)

Chapter 4

Raven's Keep - Fixed a bug where the players could hand over the royal summit invitation to the king before they actually had it.
Bredon Village - Fixed a bug where the "Link to the past" quest would advance before the player had it if they examined the statue in the town square.

notes.title: Patch 1.02c
notes.content:
Another small patch to fix some minor glitches

Chapter 3

Side-quest: The Lost Blade - Quality of life improvements in interactions w/ the NPC during the blade reforging.
Old Raven's Keep: Fixed a glitch where the screen would dim during an inn stay but never return

General
Added a couple carrots to the world in places snowmen are found. You know what to do.

notes.title: Patch 1.02b
notes.content:
Small patch to fix a couple problems.

Chapter 2

Blocked off and altered some of the NPCs in Jarith so they won't be so inclined to be in the way.

Chapter 3

Fixed a potential bug where it was possible for the player to become invisible after entering Sanchi Verde in the desert.
Altered some of the shadowing in one of the rooms of Sanchi Verde to better obscure "things" until they are revealed.

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Small patch to fix problems related to the Order of the Wind sidequest

Order of the Wind sidequest

Fixed a bug that could cause the entire quest to go off the rails, resulting in the party being left without Madilyn.
Modified the restricted library to encourage more exploration of books. 
Buffed Paige's hitpoints to be absolutely sure she won't be defeated in the encounter.

notes.title: Patch 1.01 - mostly non-critical bugs (mostly)
notes.content:
Quick patch to address some issues with the game. Some more serious than others.

Chapter 1

Addressed an issue where the game would not immediately end if you run out of time inside the cave of the opening sequence.
Fixed an issue (hopefully) where the docks would become inaccessible sometimes. 
    - Note: The dock will become *completely* inaccessible once the story progresses sufficiently. Although the boat will be available.
Fixed an issue where the boat could be boarded prematurely.
Kaliko Village: Fixed some dialogue related to a couple villagers not knowing the mayor's son was back. (Sidequest: The Prodigal Son)
Redesigned the landscape so that the boat could not become inaccessible if deboarding directly into The Frostbite. 
   - This was actually fixed in chapter 2 and on, but the fix never made it into chapter 1. (oopsie)
Gorogo: fixed an issue with an NPC displaying the wrong image if interacted with.
Gorogo: Fixed an issue where the game was able to be soft locked if backtracking.


Chapter 2

Fixed an issue where the player could bypass a barrier in the giant trees section, allowing for sequence breaking.

Chapter 4

Fixed an issue where the wrong player sprite was shown sometimes in the catacombs.

Post-game

Fixed an issue with boarding/deboarding the airship while flying that would take the player to an undesired area.
Fixed party NPCs on the deck being improperly displayed.

General fixes

Adjusted Winter's knives. They are now the same knives and will sell for the same price.
Fixed a typo in the help system.

Please report any bugs you may find in either the Steam discussion area or the discord. I'll try to patch them out as soon as possible.
